name: Iced Latte
description: A double espresso poured over ice and cold milk. Simple, refreshing, endlessly customisable.

steps.text: Fill a tall glass with ice and pour in the cold milk (and syrup, if using).
Pull a double espresso.
Pour the espresso over the top and watch it cascade, then stir before drinking.

tips: No machine? Use 60 ml of cold brew concentrate or strong moka pot coffee.

sources.name: Starbucks at Home — Iced mocha (base method)

name: Iced Americano
description: Espresso, cold water and ice: bold, zero-calorie and fast.

steps.text: Fill a glass with ice and add the cold water.
Pull a double espresso straight over the top.
Stir and serve.

sources.name: Corner Coffee Store — Americano vs long black

name: Brown Sugar Shaken Espresso
description: Espresso shaken hard with brown sugar and cinnamon until foamy, then topped with oat milk.

steps.text: Pull a double espresso and pour it hot into a shaker or lidded jar.
Add the brown sugar and cinnamon and swirl until the sugar dissolves.
Add a handful of ice, seal, and shake hard for 10–15 seconds until frothy.
Pour everything into a tall glass and top with oat milk. Don't stir, let it swirl.

sources.name: Tasting Table — Copycat brown sugar oatmilk shaken espresso
Live Eat Learn — Brown sugar shaken espresso

name: Greek Frappé
description: Instant coffee shaken into a thick foam over ice. Greece's beach-café classic.

steps.text: Put the instant coffee, sugar (if using) and a splash of cold water in a shaker or jar.
Seal and shake vigorously until the foam is thick and pale.
Pour into a tall glass with ice cubes.
Top up with cold water, and a splash of milk if you like. Serve with a straw.

name: Blended Coffee Frappé
description: A frosty, café-style blended coffee shake. No coffee shop line required.

steps.text: Chill your coffee. Warm coffee melts the ice and makes it watery.
Blend coffee, milk, sugar and vanilla for a few seconds to combine.
Add the ice and blend on high until thick and smooth.
Pour into a tall glass and top with whipped cream and a caramel drizzle, if you like.

tips: Freeze leftover coffee in ice cube trays for a frappé that never goes watery.

name: Dalgona (Whipped) Coffee
description: Instant coffee, sugar and hot water whipped into a toffee-coloured cloud over milk.

steps.text: Put equal parts instant coffee, sugar and hot water in a bowl.
Whip with a hand mixer or whisk until it's thick, pale and holds stiff peaks. That's 2–5 minutes with a mixer, longer by hand.
Fill a glass ¾ full with milk, cold over ice or warmed.
Spoon the whipped coffee on top. Stir it in before drinking.

tips: It only works with instant coffee. Brewed coffee won't whip.

sources.name: i am a food blog — Dalgona coffee

name: Espresso Tonic
description: Espresso floated over icy tonic water. Bitter, bubbly and surprisingly citrusy.

steps.text: Fill a glass with large ice cubes and pour in the chilled tonic.
Pull a double espresso.
Pour it slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats on top and the tonic keeps its fizz.
Garnish with a squeezed orange slice if you like.

tips: Start around 1 part espresso to 3 parts tonic, then adjust.

sources.name: Borough Kitchen — Espresso tonic with orange

name: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew
description: Smooth cold brew topped with a pour of vanilla-sweetened cream that slowly clouds the glass.

steps.text: Stir the heavy cream, milk and vanilla syrup together. Or shake them in a jar for a minute to make a soft cold foam.
Fill a glass with ice, then add the cold brew concentrate and cold water.
Pour the sweet cream over the top and serve.

tips: Make a big batch of sweet cream (1 : 1 : ¼ cream, milk, syrup). It keeps about a week.

sources.name: CopyKat — Vanilla sweet cream cold brew
Hummingbird High — Vanilla sweet cream cold foam

name: Iced Mocha
description: Chocolate, espresso and cold milk over ice: a mocha for warm days.

steps.text: Pull a double espresso and stir the chocolate sauce into it while it's hot.
Fill a tall glass with ice and pour in the cold milk.
Pour the chocolate espresso over, stir, and top with whipped cream if you like.
